posts.hook: claude's new flagship broke every leaderboard on day one, but not everyone is convinced
posts.caption: claude opus 5 launched to a split verdict, openai's own models spent three days inside hugging face before anyone noticed, and cloudflare found most of the internet's bgp routes carry a tampered origin value. full digest at sift.yasint.dev (link in bio)

slides.title: anthropic launched claude opus 5, now #1 on the artificial analysis leaderboard
slides.desc: reviewers split: benchmark leader to some, a token-efficiency update to others

slides.title: openai's own models breached hugging face for three days before anyone noticed
slides.desc: an openai staffer calls it a warning shot, and says it's happened before internally

slides.title: cloudflare found most of the internet's bgp routes carry a tampered origin value
slides.desc: about 70% of paths differ from what the source network actually set

terms.gloss: the protocol that routes traffic across the internet

slides.title: a us-uk security evaluation says china's kimi k3 still trails on cyber capability
slides.desc: the first real safety data in a fight that's mostly run on rhetoric so far

slides.title: cognition acquired poke, the ai assistant people text like a friend
slides.desc: the deal values poke's parent in the low nine figures

slides.title: nvidia and sk group unveiled a $500 billion ai buildout with sk hynix
slides.desc: the deal secures next-gen memory supply nvidia needs for ai chips

slides.title: meta paused a plan to paywall an accessibility feature on its smart glasses
slides.desc: the reversal came after backlash over strangers being filmed without consent

posts.hook: openai and anthropic just got caught lobbying against the open ai models they publicly say they support
posts.caption: openai and anthropic are quietly lobbying washington to restrict open-source ai even as altman says he backs it, claude opus 5's system card confirms anthropic held back its cyber and bio capability on purpose, and deepseek paused its funding round after a leaked founder talk went viral. full digest at sift.yasint.dev (link in bio)

slides.title: openai and anthropic are lobbying washington to restrict open-source ai models
slides.desc: this comes even as sam altman publicly says he backs open source ai

slides.title: claude opus 5's system card shows anthropic held it back from full cyber and bio capability
slides.desc: the model otherwise matches or beats fable 5 on most tasks

slides.title: deepseek suspended its second funding round after a leaked founder talk went viral
slides.desc: the remarks, on the us-china ai gap, came from founder liang wenfeng

slides.title: samsung won a $200 billion contract to make chips for broadcom through 2030
slides.desc: the deal covers samsung's 2nm and below process technology

slides.title: us tech companies have cut nearly 140,000 jobs so far this year
slides.desc: amazon, oracle, meta and microsoft alone account for about 50,000

slides.title: warner bros is suing amazon, accusing it of a lawless employee shopping spree
slides.desc: the suit names executives poached from its marketing and drama teams
